findings.finding: Both selected native blame entry sites are fatal-handler paths; the frozen fixture is an ordinary synchronous authored caller. No native/signal eligibility follows.

Admission, entered event, callback prepared-return transcript, actual callback return, private raw capture, authoritative record and acquire-gated completion are distinct. Suppressed nested entries read no request/provider fields. No intermediate payload exposure is introduced.

Full nonnegative int64 including zero is an opaque fixture token; native code uses int fd. A native provider needs exact ABI, provenance and checked 0..INT_MAX conversion before use. Valid number alone does not exclude foreign close/reuse.

Missing reached callback or invalid result can halt after successful OPEN without compensating CLOSE. Establish stable complete reachable functions and conversions as provider prerequisites without changing reached-only validation or adding another admission; external cleanup custody must remain explicit.

Authored failure_errno is not native errno capture. Capture native raw return and valid failure error before any helper/log/nested/next call; distinguish synthetic conversion/custody refusal. Caller-entry errno preservation remains a separate contract.

The selected blame path writes once and proceeds to sync/close after ordinary return. A different sig_write helper retries; substituting it changes behavior. No EINTR or short-write retry is authorized.
Canonical copied fixture identity accepts a broader syntax than SDK cm_id_ok. Immutable ownership value does not establish SDK admission or filesystem authority.

Conditional source reasoning: if writing foobar leaves exactly foo, next startup reads that prefix and a distinct foo record is present in g_cm at startup, exact cm_find can select foo and create its crashed marker. Both IDs meet SDK syntax. This is not observed I/O/startup/fault/causation and changes no protection.
Void ordinary return cannot report live-mod/clock/open/write/sync/close outcomes. NoCommunity completion without known_failure does not acknowledge append or quarantine persistence.

Postclaim per-TID fencing, prior-action publication, ignored install returns, alternate stacks and native frame reads retain separate signal/nonlocal/cross-thread lifetime gates. Guarded ordinary nested losers do not resolve them.

Preserve five setup-only APIs, six exact reader/type fragments, sole admission and immutable completed ownership. Retained LL/SC retry, libc/canary/sanitizer and per-slot-not-coherent limits remain; no new machine-code or native binding evidence.

next_scope: Next make a separately scoped source-only ordinary-file custody plan. Specify a fixed provider table/context and an owned temporary directory/file capability for one ordinary synchronous entry using the frozen engine and exact readers; keep frame cells and owner inputs authored. Define native int descriptor provenance and checked widening/narrowing, value/error capture before instrumentation, entered/returned/recorded/completed receipts, close uncertainty and terminal no-retry behavior, plus explicit cleanup custody outside the terminal attempt. Use fresh process/file identities and bounded exact controls before any implementation. Preserve the opaque unblamed boundary; do not invoke CM_BLAME, CM_CRASHES or native quarantine/startup policy. No adapter, native I/O, compiler, runtime matrix, callback/nesting, handler/signal/nonlocal exit, concurrent publication, DSO/installer, emulator/device, production or live work is authorized in that plan slice. Preserve all frozen sources/failures, LL/SC/libc/canary limits and every closed live gate; do not replay completed retention, audits or matrices unchanged.

Define failed/interrupted/unknown close disposition without blind retry or token reuse; external cleanup cannot reset/reopen the terminal attempt.
Keep CM_BLAME, CM_CRASHES, startup suspension and all quarantine/protections unchanged. Ownership is not fault causation.
Retain opaque unblamed and authored frame/module inputs; no native frame adapter, actual persistence or live availability is inferred.

provider_mappings.established: The engine accepts raw >= 0, including zero, as an opaque int64 token; native code stores an int and gates fd >= 0. A selected owner is independent of open success.

provider_mappings.not_proved: Actual open, native token width/binding, correct path/file identity, exclusion of other fd users and durable creation are untested.
requirements: Require native int descriptor provenance and 0..INT_MAX before any narrowing; do not cast arbitrary nonnegative fixture tokens to int.
Bind the opened file/path and descriptor custody to stable context; copied owner identity authorizes no filesystem effect by itself.
Record raw native return and capture its error immediately on failure, before instrumentation, any next call or normalization; entry/caller error-state policy is separate.

requirements: Keep exact requested bytes/length alive until ordinary native return; no private pointer may escape the callback.

Separate any external cleanup owner and evidence from engine completion; no inferred drain or reclamation.
